label: Weekend of Nov 13–15
status: LIVE — Challenger Cup semifinals: Toronto Jr Canadiens 3-0 Nashville (Dearborn); Little Caesars 2-1 Team Illinois (Hazel Park) — both after one period
note: Ranks are MHR’s Nov 11 ratings and move live as results come in. Game times are local to the rink. Many rinks stream on LiveBarn.

summary: SEMIFINALS ARE SET at the Little Caesars Challenger Cup. Sunday 8:30 AM Central (9:30 Detroit): Nashville Jr. Predators (#8, 96.50) vs Toronto Jr Canadiens (CAN) at Dearborn, and Little Caesars (#3, 97.50) vs Team Illinois (#5, 97.06) at Hazel Park. The final is 2:30 PM Central (3:30 Detroit) at BELFOR.

Division winners: Toronto Jr Canadiens won Division A at 4-0, with three shutouts and 20 goals for, 1 against. Little Caesars took Division B at 3-0-1. Team Illinois won Division C at 4-0 with two shutouts. Nashville won Division D at 3-0-1.

Game of the day: Pittsburgh Penguins Elite (#12, 96.17) led Nashville 3-0 into the 3rd. Nashville scored four goals in 3:06 to go up 4-3, and Tristan Leduc tied it 4-4 with 44 seconds left. That set up a must-win Saturday night for Pittsburgh: the Penguins needed to beat Masters by four or more goals to pass Nashville and win Division D. Masters (#25) held them to a 2-2 tie instead, so Nashville is in the semis and Pittsburgh (2-0-2) is out.

What the ratings say: Toronto Jr Canadiens (CAN, about 98.1) are roughly 1.5 goals better than Nashville on paper, so they're the favorite to reach the final. Little Caesars vs Team Illinois is a near coin flip, with LC rated only about 0.4 goals higher. The most likely final is Toronto vs the LC/Illinois winner.

Head to head this season: Team Illinois won the only earlier meeting with Little Caesars, 3-2 at LC on September 19. Toronto and Nashville haven't met. Among common opponents, Little Caesars beat Nashville 5-0 in August and Team Illinois beat Nashville 4-1 in September.

Other stories: Seacoast (#22, 94.37) came back from 2-0 down in the 3rd to tie Little Caesars 2-2, the only blemish on LC's record. Top Gun (#11, 96.25) started 0-2 but won its last two, including 5-2 over Windy City.

Players to watch in the semis: Pittsburgh's Tristan Leduc leads the event with 10 points. Toronto's Tristan Reynolds has 9 points (7 goals) on the game sheets so far, and Nashville's Sebastien Erat and Lincoln Brown have 7 each. Tap any game for every goal, assist and penalty.
Also: Chicago Mission (#6) beat the Reapers 4-3 in a shootout in their home-and-home exhibition. The rematch is Sunday at 9:10 AM.

Note: Fox Motors (#27) played four games on the Challenger Cup schedule, against Boston Jr Eagles, Seacoast, Upper Canada College and Huron-Perth, and won all four. They're listed as a 14U/U15 entry, not in any of the four divisions, so they aren't in the standings, the bracket or the report card. Their games still count in the ratings.

summary: Little Caesars (#8, 93.08) are hosting a three-team round robin in Detroit with Bishop Kearney Selects (#2, 95.55) and Shattuck St Mary's (#4, 94.33). Each pair plays twice.
So far: Bishop Kearney won 3-1 at LC on Thursday. On Friday Shattuck beat Bishop Kearney 6-2 (an upset over the #2 team), and LC answered with a 5-1 win over Shattuck.

Mount St Charles (#3, 95.02) beat PAL Jr Islanders 9-1. Then the big one: Little Caesars (#8, 93.43) came back from 2-0 down to beat Bishop Kearney (#2, 95.05) 5-2, scoring three times in the 3rd. LC and Bishop Kearney have now split, and LC is 2-1 at its own event. Tonight Shattuck (#4, 94.39) shut out Little Caesars (#8, 93.37) 3-0. Every team is 2-1 entering Sunday's Bishop Kearney vs Shattuck finale.
Chicago Reapers (#5, 93.64) beat Chicago Mission (#8, 93.37) 4-1 at Elk Grove. Rematch Sunday 1:30 PM at Mount Prospect.
Chicago Reapers (#5, 93.53) and Chicago Mission (#6, 93.46) play twice: Saturday 2:40 PM at Elk Grove and Sunday 1:30 PM at Mount Prospect.

Also this weekend: St. Louis Blues (#12, 92.19), Philadelphia Jr Flyers (#17, 91.45), North Jersey Avalanche (#21, 90.98) and Victory Honda (#22, 90.59) are at a showcase at Arctic Ice Arena. Mount St Charles (#3, 95.00) plays PAL Jr Islanders three times in league play, and Woodbridge (#9, 92.78) plays South Kent School twice. Penguins Elite (#1, 96.16) have no games listed.
